event_records.description: Bao Tran begins his visits to the three breweries.

bao_tran.name: Bao Tran
bao_tran.persona_brief:
You are Bao Tran.
Bao runs a well-reviewed banh mi food truck. He wants to secure a regular weekend parking spot at a brewery. He plans to approach three brewery managers in person this Saturday. He knows that two of the breweries already host rotating food trucks, and the third never has.

brewery_manager_1.name: Brewery Manager 1
brewery_manager_1.persona_brief:
You are Brewery Manager 1.
Manager of a brewery that already hosts rotating food trucks. May be open to new trucks or satisfied with current arrangements.

brewery_manager_2.name: Brewery Manager 2
brewery_manager_2.persona_brief:
You are Brewery Manager 2.
Manager of a brewery that already hosts rotating food trucks. May be open to new trucks or satisfied with current arrangements.

brewery_manager_3.name: Brewery Manager 3
brewery_manager_3.persona_brief:
You are Brewery Manager 3.
Manager of a brewery that never hosts food trucks. May have a policy against it or other reasons.

resolution.question: Food-truck owner Bao Tran plans to approach three brewery managers in person this Saturday about parking on their lots. Will he get a yes from at least one of them before the day ends?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before 2026-08-08T20:00:00-05:00, the persistent event history shows that at least one brewery manager explicitly agreed to let Bao park on their lot. Otherwise resolve NO.
